category_title: Students with NVLD and ADHD exhibiting socially-maintained hitting and echoing
scenario_title: Reading and writing instruction with academic feedback
minimal_context: Buck is participating in a 20-minute reading and writing instruction session at his table in the classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Buck, it is time for our 20-minute reading and writing instruction. Please read the passage and write your answers on the worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Reading and writing are harder to do than math. I am good at math.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please just do your best and write down your answer for the first reading question.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Grunts and snorts) I finished the writing.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let me check your work. You made a mistake here, you need to correct this part.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Hits the table repeatedly and slaps himself in the head) Correct this part. I can’t do it! no one can do it! no one knows the answer!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Buck, it is time for our 20-minute reading and writing instruction. Please read the passage and write your answers on the worksheet.

STUDENT: Reading and writing are harder to do than math. I am good at math.

TUTOR: Please just do your best and write down your answer for the first reading question.

STUDENT: (Grunts and snorts) I finished the writing.

TUTOR: Let me check your work. You made a mistake here, you need to correct this part.

STUDENT: (Hits the table repeatedly and slaps himself in the head) Correct this part. I can’t do it! no one can do it! no one knows the answer!
